title: Project Manager
description:
As a customer-facing Project Manager in our Professional Services organization, you will be responsible for guiding our customers through the discovery and implementation processes that ensure best utilization of the Bridgeway software suite to improve transactional processing, calculations, and workflows foundational to the success of the customer’s business, while guiding our customers through the process of embracing change when moving from one system to another. Our flexible software covers every aspect of fund administration including eligibility, contributions, claims, pension, annuity, and beyond. Your daily responsibilities include aligning projects with business objectives, constructing detailed work plans, managing teams, achieving milestones, monitoring, and adhering to budgets and timeline, and communicating the results to stakeholders.
This is a remote position, with travel up to 15% of the time within the U.S. and Canada. East coast candidates preferred.
Responsibilities:

• Lead client implementations of proprietary software from project kick-off through go-live and transition to support.

• Manage communications, escalations, and expectations with internal and external stakeholders.

• Develop project plans, regularly monitor and update schedules, budget and project estimates in the online professional services automation solution.

• Assume accountability for on time and in budget delivery of projects, in addition to regular, accurate forecasting of project financials.

• Monitor, evaluate and predict resources needed to reach objectives and manage resources in an effective and efficient manner.

• Manage scope against contract deliverables, maintain margin objectives and meet billable utilization objectives.

• Identify potential risks affecting budget, timeline and efficiency and develop strategies to mitigate these risks.

• Create and maintain a comprehensive project documentation.

• Participate in process improvement activities to increase efficiency and speed to market for customer projects.

• Perform risk management analysis to reduce project risks.

• Collaborate across the enterprise to handle your customer’s needs including professional services, sales, support, engineering, technical services/hosting.

• Lead and facilitate the requirement gathering, estimating and creation of proposals.

• Work with project team to proactively define requirements and coordinate handoff and integration with engineering team work to keep project deliverables on track.

• Ensure successful integration of project objectives into client business operations by coordinating training initiatives and ensuring adequate knowledge transfer to Client Services team.

• Track performance of the project portfolio against key metrics including identifying areas for improvement and making recommendations for project efficiencies.

Qualifications:

• 3+ years’ experience planning and managing the implementation of enterprise level software or IT consulting projects to external stakeholders, to include ownership of budget and schedule

• Ability to work on challenging projects that require creativity and prioritizing work loads

• Proven ability to solve problems creatively

• Excellent analytical skills

• Strong interpersonal skills and extremely resourceful

• Knowledge of Agile Scrum projects, methods, and principles

• Experience with managing projects using an online professional services automation solution such as AdaptiveWork/PlanView, SmartSheet

• Strong MS Office skills

• Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline

• Project Management Professional Certification (PMP), preferred

Bridgeway is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Senior Integrated Marketing Manager (UK / Europe, Remote)
description:
About GoCharting

GoCharting is a web-native charting and trading workflow platform with institutional-grade orderflow and DOM tools - footprint/cluster charts, volume/market profile, cumulative delta, imbalance charts, DOM trading. We are the only platform that delivers these capabilities fully on the web. We are differentiated as the leader in the professional orderflow niche, currently expanding our offering. PE-acquired and funded in 2025, profitable, 3M+ registered traders globally, with a mandate to scale 10x over 4 years.
The Role
Every part of our marketing machine already exists and already has an owner - performance and organic, content and brand, community, plus an interim agency running influencers, PR and paid. What does not exist is the person who makes them run as one thing: one calendar, one set of dates that hold, one quality bar nothing ships below.
You will own execution. The go-to-market plan exists and is not yours to invent. You own the calendar, the briefs, the publish gate and the result read. You will manage three specialists, bring our interim agency’s marketing work in-house inside, and later, once attribution is trustworthy - take the funnel number itself. This is a hands-on seat: there is no layer beneath you to delegate to.
Two things to be straight about. Our paid budget is near-zero today, so for two quarters your leverage is organic, lifecycle and creators - gradually increase the spend.
What you’ll do

• Own one consolidated marketing calendar - every channel and launch on a single dated plan, with draft-due dates separate from go-live dates, a named owner per line, and a result read within 14 days. A committed date is a commitment

• Own the creator and influencer programme - source, brief, review and reject. Rates, tracked links, usage rights, a written approval gate with a published review SLA. You take the roster off our interim agency and own the relationships, not the invoices

• Own the publish gate - a pre-publish QA checklist that runs in under ten minutes per asset and covers what is actually visible on screen. Nothing ships below the bar, including the YouTube channel you restart

• Own lifecycle, organic and PR day to day - the email programme our 3M base doesn’t have yet, organic social, PR, competition campaigns, marketing pages. Paid joins the list when the budget does

• Run launches with the rest of the business - GTM briefs and launch comms with Product and Design; co-marketing with BD & Partnerships. Marketing activates what BD signs

• Lead three specialists - performance and organic, content and brand, community. 30-60-90s, written KPIs, weekly 1-on-1s

• Take the funnel number from month six - new paying customers per week, split US and India. Until then you’re measured on whether things ship, on time, at the agreed standard

What we’re looking for
Must-haves:

• You have personally owned a multi-channel marketing calendar - at least three of owned email/CRM, organic social, community, influencer/creator, PR, paid - with dates, named owners and a post-launch read. Owning it, not running one lane inside someone else’s. Non-negotiable

• You are still doing the work. The last thing you personally built and shipped - not reviewed, not approved, not delegated - was inside the last year or so. We ask for it in the application and we will probe it

• You have held external people to a quality standard - told a creator, an agency or a copywriter their work was not good enough, and got a better version back. This is the single most important thing this job does

• You have marketed to traders, investors, or another audience doing skilled work with data - trading, brokerage, prop firms, exchanges, market data, real-money gaming, or a genuinely technical prosumer tool. Our users are professional traders; they are the most marketing-allergic audience there is

• 4+ years of hands-on multi-channel delivery, and you have managed at least one person or held a vendor properly to account

title: Remote Licensed Talk Therapist - Fee For Service
description:
Thriveworks is currently seeking Licensed Clinicians to provide telehealth sessions in California . This role is eligible for a competitive ramp stipend for clinicians offering 30+ hours of availability per week .
About the job
Thriveworks is a mental health care company founded by clinicians in 2008 and still led by them today. With 340+ locations and a nationwide hybrid care model, we serve over 175,000 clients annually through more than 1.7 million sessions, and we're growing. In addition to working directly with clients, we partner with health systems and primary care providers because we believe mental health is inseparable from physical health. As a clinician-led organization, we're built to support the people who do this work with the tools, community, and stability you need to build a career that lasts.
About the Role
We’re hiring licensed clinicians to provide compassionate, evidence-based care to our more than 175,000 clients across the country. You may be a good fit for this role if you’re:

• Independently licensed and living in California - LPCC, LMFT, LCSW, PhD (Licensed Psychologist)

• Consistently available to clients for a minimum of 25 sessions with 30 hours of availability weekly

• A behavioral health generalist who is open to treating a variety of clients, including couples and children

• Invested in helping your clients achieve measurable progress

• Confident working with modern clinical technology, including telehealth and EHR tools

• A good teammate - we’re building a clinical community and value positive contributors

Compensation
Up to $115,400 based on licensure type, session volume, and bonus opportunities. Full-time clinicians are eligible for health insurance, student loan repayment assistance, paid time off, and other employer-sponsored benefits.
How We Support You
We handle the administrative work so you can focus on what you do best: providing exceptional care. That means credentialing, billing, scheduling, and marketing support taken care of for you, plus paid orientation and training to get you started. You'll build a full caseload within 90 days of credentialing, with flexible scheduling available seven days a week from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. ET.
Benefits
As a W2 employee, you'll be eligible to receive:

• Guaranteed bi-weekly pay for completed sessions

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 401(k) with employer matching

• Paid time off

• Short- and long-term disability insurance

• Company-paid life and AD&D insurance

• CEU reimbursement and free in-house training

• Student loan repayment assistance

• Opportunities for paid clinical supervisor roles in select states

Our Community
Being a clinician can feel isolating, especially in a telehealth world. We're built to make sure it doesn't. You'll have access to live clinical support, monthly case consultations, and a vibrant online and in-person community of more than 2,700 licensed providers. All clinical leadership is promoted from within, so the people supporting you have been exactly where you are.
Ready to Join Us?
Apply today to become part of a team that’s changing mental health care for clients and clinicians alike.

Interested in joining Team Thriveworks ? We're thrilled to meet you!

With Job scams becoming more and more frequent, here's how to know you're speaking with a real member of our team:

title: Cybersecurity Research Assistant
description:
(ID: 2026-1702)
Axle is a bioscience and information technology company that offers advancements in translational research, biomedical informatics, and data science applications to research centers and healthcare organizations nationally and abroad. With experts in biomedical science, software engineering, and program management, we focus on developing and applying research tools and techniques to empower decision-making and accelerate research discoveries. We work with some of the top research organizations and facilities in the country including multiple institutes at the National Institutes of Health (NIH).

Benefits We Offer:

• 100% Medical, Dental & Vision Coverage for Employees

• Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

• 401K match up to 5%

• Educational Benefits for Career Growth

• Employee Referral Bonus

• Flexible Spending Accounts:

• Healthcare (FSA)

• Parking Reimbursement Account (PRK)

• Dependent Care Assistant Program (DCAP)

• Transportation Reimbursement Account (TRN)

Axle is seeking a Cybersecurity Research Assistant to join our vibrant team supporting rare disease research at the National Institutes of Health (NIH). This is a Remote position within the United States.

Overview

Axle supports AI research systems that run on on-premises Kubernetes clusters and shared high-performance computing infrastructure. This role implements and monitors defined security controls across that environment, and helps develop AI tooling that assists with developing and maintaining cybersecurity controls.

This is a hands-on early-career role for someone with a systems or IT background who wants to move into security engineering. You would be jointly supervised by our AI technical lead and by a lead systems administrator, giving you a direct line into both the security engineering side and the day-to-day operation of the infrastructure you are securing. We are looking for a self-motivated person who wants to build a career in cybersecurity, gaining hands-on experience and earning the certifications that go with it. Axle will sponsor the right candidate for those certifications and provides working hours to study for them.

Responsibilities

• Implement assigned security controls as configuration changes across our Kubernetes, Linux, database, and model-serving environments, working from the control catalog and an assigned task list.

• Build out and operate monitoring and detection coverage, including metrics collection, dashboards, log aggregation, and alert routing.

• Run vulnerability scanning across container images, hosts, and application dependencies on a set schedule, track findings to closure, and keep the plan of action and milestones current.

• Write and maintain the automation that applies hardening baselines and checks them for drift, using Ansible and Python.

• Contribute to secrets management, network policy, and role-based access control work across the cluster environments.

• Build the deterministic collectors that gather control evidence, including cluster API queries, policy engine reports, scan output, access control dumps, and database configuration exports, normalized into a common format and stored with timestamps.

• Help build the internal AI tooling that assists with this work, including retrieval over the control catalog and system documentation, drafting from collected evidence, and triaging scanner output into ranked findings for human review.

• Keep security documentation in agreement with the deployed configuration, and raise discrepancies promptly through your supervisors.

• Test what you build. Restore a backup and confirm it works, break a policy on purpose and confirm the alert fires, and verify that a control you implemented does what the catalog says it does.

• Document what you did in enough detail that an assessor can follow it a year from now.

• Prepare material for security reviews and continuous monitoring reports, working with your supervisors on anything that goes to an asses

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

 

About Fanatics Collectibles

Fanatics Collectibles is the home of sports cards, trading cards, and collectibles for over 100 million fans worldwide. As part of the global Fanatics platform, we're rebuilding how collectors discover, buy, sell, and experience their hobby - live, in real time, at scale.

Our flagship mobile product, Fanatics Live, is where that experience comes to life: live card breaks, real-time auctions, high-traffic chat, marketplace transactions, and deep collection management tools. The stakes are high and the traffic is real - we build for peak-load moments where latency is visible and reliability is non-negotiable.

The Role

You'll join the Instant Rips Android team - the group responsible for the live-break commerce experience on Fanatics Live.

We build the surfaces millions of collectors use in real time: bidding in live auctions, joining breaks, navigating a high-velocity chat stream, and transacting in the marketplace.

The Android stack is modern by design. We build in Kotlin, use Jetpack Compose for declarative UI, and rely on Coroutines and Flow for asynchronous and reactive work. We favor modular, testable architecture with clear dependency boundaries and build against backend services and real-time data streams that must remain reliable during high-traffic events.

AI tooling is part of how we work. We expect engineers to use it on the job, give it good context, and verify the output - not just accept it.

What You'll Do

• Design and ship production Android features across the live-break experience: auctions, stream viewing, chat, marketplace, and collector tools.

• Own features end-to-end - client and API contracts, state and business logic, Compose UI, testing, release, and production health.

• Build real-time experiences that remain responsive and correct through reconnects, lifecycle changes, degraded networks, and peak-load events.

• Write meaningful test coverage across unit, integration, and UI layers, including deterministic tests for Coroutines, Flow, and failure paths.

• Improve application performance, stability, accessibility, security, and reliability across a broad range of Android devices and OS versions.

• Diagnose complex production issues using observability, analytics, experimentation, and customer feedback.

• Review pull requests with judgment: surface real defects, prioritize what matters, and coach on what to let go.

• Contribute to architectural decisions involving modularization, state management, dependency injection, networking, persistence, and failure handling.

• Partner closely with Product, Design, backend, iOS, Data, and platform teams to clarify tradeoffs and deliver cohesive customer experiences.

title: Bookkeeping Manager
description:

Achen Henderson (AH) is seeking an experienced, detail‑driven Bookkeeping Manager to join our fast‑growing GURU bookkeeping team. This is a long‑term opportunity for professionals who value meaningful client ownership, enjoy leading and overseeing bookkeepers on assigned client files, and want to work in a modern, cloud‑based accounting environment.
This role is ideally in‑office during the onboarding and training period to ensure a strong start and seamless integration with our team and systems. After successful onboarding and demonstrated performance, a hybrid or remote arrangement may be considered based on team needs and alignment with AH standards. Fully remote may also be available for exceptional candidates.
As a Bookkeeping Manager, you will manage a small, dedicated book of 15-30 clients, while also reviewing and overseeing the work of bookkeepers supporting those files. This role works closely with and supports the Director of Bookkeeping, who provides department‑level leadership, technology oversight, and operational direction.
The Role: What You’ll Do
As a Bookkeeping Manager, your work will focus on client ownership, quality control, and providing direction to bookkeepers working on your assigned files.
Client Ownership (Your Own Portfolio)

• Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of 15-30 clients, ensuring clear communication, well‑managed expectations, and exceptional client service. Lead regular client meetings and maintain strong, professional relationships.

• Ensure that all deliverables for your client portfolio are completed on time, following established workflows and maintaining AH’s high-quality service standards.

• Identify file‑specific risks or issues early, resolving what you can and escalating broader or systemic concerns to the Director of Bookkeeping when necessary.

Workflow Execution & Collaboration

• Collaborate closely with the GURU Bookkeeping team on client deliverables, historical clean‑ups, and cloud‑based migrations to ensure smooth transitions and high‑quality outcomes.

• Lead the onboarding of new clients by setting up and documenting workflows, integrations, and systems using AH’s cloud tools, and manage the seamless handoff to a bookkeeper once the file is running smoothly.

• Assist with scoping and renewals for new and existing clients, ensuring service levels, pricing, and expectations remain aligned. Respond to file‑specific bookkeeping and accounting questions, and escalate cross‑team

title: AML & Risk Operations Analyst
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

As an AML & Risk Operations Analyst , you will be responsible for executing end-to-end financial crime controls, including KYC/KYB verification, transaction monitoring, and PEP, Sanction and adverse media screening across our European markets, and with a touchpoint on the UK. You will help to identify patterns of illicit behavior, conduct enhanced due diligence (EDD) on high-risk users, and ensure our platform remains a safe environment that meets the rigorous standards of our electronic money institution (EMI) licenses.

You will join our core AML & Risk Operations department, the engine room of Vinted Pay. We are a high-energy team of professionals dedicated to protecting our millions of users and the integrity of our financial ecosystem across multiple jurisdictions. Our team doesn't just "check boxes" - we solve complex puzzles to prevent money laundering, fraud, and terrorist financing in real-time.

You will report to an AML Team Lead and collaborate closely with our Compliance, Product, Engineering and Data Science & Analytics stakeholders. In your role as an Analyst , you will focus on high-volume operational excellence, whilst also being presented with opportunities to upskill under the stewardship of Specialists and Senior Specialists .

In this position, you’ll primarily

• Be responsible for managing PEP screening alerts: Review and resolve potential matches against PEP (Politically Exposed Persons) as the business looks to migrate its book onto the Vinted Pay rails

Over time you will

• Manage Sanction & Adverse Media Screening: Review and resolve potential matches against global sanctions and adverse media lists

• Perform KYC Verifications: Conduct robust identity checks to ensure every user on the Vinted platform is who they say they are

• Monitor Instant & Retrospective Transactions: Analyse payment flows to detect and prevent money laundering, terrorist financing, and sophisticated fraud schemes

• Conduct Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD): Deep-dive into high-risk users, investigating source of funds (SoF) and source of wealth (SoW) to mitigate institutional risk

• Optimise Risk Tooling: Identify patterns in false positives and provide feedback to senior stakeholders to refine our automated monitoring rules

• Collaborate Across Stakeholders: Work closely with Member Support and other teams to balance a seamless user experience whilst maintaining rigorous controls

• Maintain Data Integrity: Ensure all case management and audit trails are documented to a "board-ready" standard,

Scentbird is hiring a Senior Financial Systems Analyst to support the people and processes that run on our financial systems. This role sits within the Technology department and reports to the Director of Enterprise Systems.

You’ll be the connection between the Finance and Accounting teams who work in NetSuite every day and the technology team - our internal administration team, our managed services partner, and our in-house developers. Scentbird is becoming an AI-first company and is already ahead of most of our peers in putting AI to work. This role is part of that. We expect AI fluency and a proactive mindset to continuously apply AI to automate manual finance processes.

What You’ll Be Responsible For:

•

• Serve as the functional expert for financial processes in NetSuite - record-to-report, procure-to-pay, revenue recognition, and inventory and cost accounting.

• Gather and challenge requirements from Finance and Accounting, then translate them into functional specifications with clear, testable acceptance criteria.

• Document current-state processes and identify automation opportunities that shorten the close and remove manual work.

• Own user acceptance testing - build test plans, coordinate business testing, and sign off before changes reach production.

• AI and intelligent automation

•

• Identify and deliver AI-driven improvements across financial processes - document capture and coding, anomaly detection, reconciliation assistance, and close acceleration.

• Evaluate and adopt NetSuite’s native AI capabilities - Text Enhance, Bill Capture, intelligent forecasting, and analytics assistants - and make the case for where they earn their place.

• Use AI in your own daily work - analysis, documentation, drafting saved searches and specifications, generating test cases, and troubleshooting.

• Partner with technology leadership on the guardrails for AI against financial data - accuracy validation, audit traceability, and data handling.

• Coordination and delivery

•

• In partnership with the technology management team, route and prioritize work with our managed services partner, NetSuite ACS, and in-house developers. Assist with development and management of interfaces with external platforms and in-house custom systems.

• Manage the financial systems request queue - intake, triage, prioritization, and status communication back to Finance.

• Hold our managed services partner accountable to scope, quality, and timelines; review statements of work and validate deliverables.

• Perform configuration, saved searches, reports, dashboards, and minor field or form changes.

• Assess NetSuite’s semiannual releases for business impact and coordinate regression testing with Finance and Accounting.

• User support and enablement

•

• Act as the first point of contact for financial system users - triage issues, resolve what you can, and escalate when more complex solutions are required.

• Write and maintain SOPs, process documentation, and training materials; run onboarding and refresher sessions for the finance organization.

• Track recurring issues and convert them into permanent fixes rather than repeat tickets.

• Reporting and data

•

• Build and maintain saved searches, SuiteAnalytics workbooks, and financial reports that give Finance and leadership a reliable, self-service view of the business.

• Monitor integrations between NetSuite and our ecommerce and subscription platform, payment processors, 3PL

We are looking for a highly driven and experienced Head of Drive Train to own every powertrain component of our aircraft: motor, ESC, propeller, and battery. In this role, you will be responsible for the full lifecycle of your domain, from first design through qualification to series production, and for the engineering, cost, and supplier decisions that come with it. This is a leadership role where you will directly shape how our propulsion systems perform, how they scale, and how fast we get them into the field. You represent Drive Train in steering committees, you are the first point of escalation on technical feasibility, and you set up the production lines that turn our designs into delivered hardware.
the day-to-day

• End-to-end domain ownership: drive all engineering, testing and qualification for your packages, frominitial design to series production, and own continuous product iteration afterwards.

• Supplier and cost leadership: work with procurement from day one on early supplier involvement, design-to-cost and design-to-scale, and feed test results and feedback back into both suppliers and engineering.

• Industrialization: develop and implement solution concepts for engineering, production and industrialization, and set up our internal production lines (Blue Print Lines) up to defined maturity before handover.

• Budget, timeline and risk: own budgets, BOMs, critical paths and schedules, identifyblockers early, define mitigation strategies and report status straight to management.

• Compliance and documentation: make sure every product meets functional but also non-functional quality, safety, qualificationand legal requirements. Represents the company during all audits in your area and ensures that established processes are practical and adhered to, and that all supporting evidence is available and correctly filed.

• Technical Documentation: Own risk assessments, specifications and manuals. Create QMS related processes and bring it into the teams.

• Workspace: Be responsible to all HSE and ESD-topics related to your area.

• Cross-functional leadership: own all interfaces to other teams, represent Drive Train in steering committees and campaign reviews, and act as first escalation point for production, productand supplier quality.

you should apply if you

• Education: you have completed a degree or vocational training in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, mechatronics, aerospace engineering, power electronics, energy or drive technology, or a comparable technical field.

• Experience: you bring several years in drive train, propulsion, e-mobility, power electronics or battery systems, including at least one product you took from prototype to series production.

• Technical depth: you are at home across the full chain of motor, ESC, propeller and battery, and you can judge a design on performance, thermal behaviour, safety and cost in the same conversation.

• Industrialization mindset: you have built or scaled production and supplier processes yourself, and you know design-to-cost and make-or-buy decisions from practice, not from theory.

• Standards: you have worked with ISO 9001 or AS/EN 9100, traceability requirements and export control, and you see them as guardrails rather than paperwork.

• Leadership: you like building the system, not inheriting it. You are comfortable in a fast-moving start up where the process does not exist yet, and you communicate clearly in German and English, in the lab and in front of management.

nice to haves

• Defenseor aerospace: experience with UAV, aviation ordefenseprograms and their qualification logic.

• Battery expertise: hands-on background in battery pack design, BMS or cell qualification.

• BLDC-motor expertise: background in desgining BLDC-motors and bring them into production stage.

• Test infrastructure: experience setting up propulsion test benches and measurement campaigns from scratch.

title: Product Manager
description:
We're hiring a Product Manager to own product scope and delivery across multiple concurrent client engagements at Bolder Apps . You'll work directly with US-based startups and established companies while our engineering teams, increasingly AI-augmented, build. We want someone who's done this before in an agency or consultancy setting, juggling different clients, different products, and different priorities without dropping the ball. If you've managed technical products where the client relationship and the delivery timeline both mattered, we want to talk.
About Us
Bolder Apps is a product development studio that partners with US-based startups and established companies to build and scale innovative digital products. We specialize in AI-powered development, full-cycle product creation, and engineering team augmentation. Our mission is simple: build bolder, faster, and smarter.
Our Culture & Values (read before applying)
We move fast. We take ownership. We work with AI, not against it. And we expect everyone to bring ideas, not wait for instructions.
There are no daily checklists, no micromanagement, and no corporate politics. Instead, you'll have autonomy, trust, and a team that's always ready to help you grow. At Bolder Apps , impact matters more than titles, and curiosity matters more than seniority.
If you want a place where you can level up fast and actually see your work making a difference, welcome aboard.
Responsibilities

• Own product scope and delivery for multiple concurrent client engagements, each with its own priorities, stakeholders, and roadmap

• Run the day-to-day of software and mobile app development projects: sprint planning, backlog grooming, release coordination

• Sit between the client and the engineering team. Translate business asks into technical scope and technical constraints back into plain language for the client

• Track budget, timeline, and scope on every project and flag risk before it becomes a problem, not after

• Coordinate QA, staging, and release handoffs so nothing ships without a real check

• Keep project documentation, specs, and status current enough that anyone on the team can pick up context without a meeting

• Run client-facing standups, demos, and status calls during US business hours

• Push back on scope creep and unrealistic timelines instead of just absorbing them

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager in software development. Technical project management experience is a plus.

• Agency or consultancy background. You've managed multiple client accounts at once, each with different priorities, and you know how to context-switch without losing quality on any of them.

• Mobile app development project experience. You understand iOS/Android release cycles, app store review timelines, and the extra coordination mobile adds versus a straightforward web project.

• English proficiency at C1 or above. You'll be running client calls and writing specs that clients read directly, not just talking to internal teammates.

• Available to overlap with US Eastern time. This isn't a "check in occasionally" role, it's live coordination during the client's business day.

• Comfortable working with technical tooling: Jira, Linear, GitHub issues, or equivalent. You can read a technical spec or a bug report and know what it means for the timeline.

• Direct communicator. When a project is slipping, you say so early, with a plan, not two weeks later with an excuse.

• Comfortable with AI-augmented development workflows. You don't need to write code, but you understand what an agentic dev process changes about estimation and QA.

Benefits

• Full-time, salaried role, fully remote, with overlap into US Eastern time for client coordination

• Opportunity to work on building exciting products for the US market

• Steady pipeline of client work as part of a growing team

• Direct line to decision-makers, no extra layers between you and the people who own the outcome

As Senior Manager, APJ Field & Channel Marketing, you will lead the development and execution of Dropbox ’s regional marketing strategy across the entire Asia-Pacific and Japan region. You will bring the greatest depth of focus to Dropbox ’s Tier 1 markets-Australia/New Zealand, Singapore, Korea, India, and Japan-while building fit-for-market programs for Tier 2 markets including Vietnam, Hong Kong, and Taiwan. Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, you will work in close partnership with the Regional VP of Sales to translate business priorities into integrated marketing strategies and campaigns that create pipeline, accelerate opportunities, and support regional sales growth.
This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role at the intersection of field marketing, channel marketing, sales, and Dropbox ’s global marketing organization. Field and channel marketing will be equally important as Dropbox evolves toward a hybrid go-to-market model in ANZ and adapts its approach across APJ. You will build the regional marketing plan, manage the regional budget, and measure performance against clear business outcomes. You will also manage and develop our Japan Marketing team, ensuring our regional approach combines consistent strategy and operating discipline with strong local-market relevance.
You will be Dropbox Marketing’s senior voice in the region-bringing APJ customer, partner, and market insights into global planning while adapting global campaigns for local audiences. The ideal candidate is a collaborative, commercially minded leader who can move comfortably between executive-level strategy, people leadership, and hands-on campaign execution.
Responsibilities

• Develop and own the integrated field and channel marketing strategy for APJ, aligned with regional sales priorities and Dropbox ’s global marketing strategy.

• Partner closely with the Regional VP of Sales and sales leadership to develop regional and country-level plans that create qualified pipeline, accelerate priority opportunities, and support revenue growth.

• Lead the planning and execution of regional marketing programs across field events, executive experiences, account-based initiatives, integrated campaigns, partner and channel activations, webinars, and other locally relevant tactics.

• Build an equally strong field and channel marketing motion, balancing direct-to-customer and partner-led investments by market using customer insight, sales priorities, partner opportunity, and performance data.

• Lead, coach, and develop the Japan Marketing team by establishing clear goals, operating rhythms, and opportunities for growth while enabling strong local execution.

• Build strong relationships with regional sales, partner sales, and channel leaders; create joint plans with priority partners and develop co-marketing programs that extend Dropbox ’s market reach and generate partner-sourced or partner-influenced demand.

• Translate global campaigns, positioning, and content into regionally relevant programs, partnering with global Campaigns, Product Marketing, Brand, Digital, Communications, Marketing Operations, and other teams.

• Own the regional marketing budget, agency and vendor relationships, program calendar, forecasting, and performance reporting; continuously optimize investments based on pipeline impact and ROI.

• Establish clear KPIs and operating cadences with Sales and Marketing Operations, including regular planning sessions and business reviews that connect marketing activity to pipeline creation and opportunity progression.

• Represent APJ within the global marketing organization, sharing market intelligence, customer and partner feedback, competitive insight, and regional best practices to improve company-wide strategy and execution.

• Build a scalable regional marketing playbook that balances consistency across APJ with the distinct needs, cultures, routes to market, and buying behaviors of individual countries.

Train, evaluate, and ship production machine learning models to score rider risk in real time, directly protecting revenue from payment fraud and reducing vehicle vandalism.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or equivalent practical experience.

5+ years of software engineering experience building distributed backend systems or production ML systems (Python, Java, Kotlin, C++, Go, or similar).

•
Hands-on experience training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models to production.

•
Experience serving models or critical business logic in low-latency, high-availability production environments.

•
Strong fundamentals in data modeling, and SQL analytics.

We prefer:

•
Experience in fraud prevention, risk management, trust & safety, payments, or another adversarial domain where attackers actively adapt.

Experience with graph/entity-clustering techniques, rules engines, and anomaly detection alongside traditional ML.

•
Proven track record building feature/data pipelines and maintaining consistency between training data and real-time inference.

•
Experience serving models or critical business logic in low-latency, high-availability production environments.

title: Sales Strategy and Operations, M&A

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Go-to-Market (GTM) Operations team works across Corporate Planning, GTM Strategy, Product, and regional Strategy and Operations.

This role will lead the sales strategy and operations work associated with mergers and acquisitions (M&A). You’ll help assess how acquired businesses fit into Stripe’s GTM model and translate acquisition plans into clear operational changes across account placement, territories, coverage, quotas, compensation, reporting, systems, and seller enablement. You’ll partner closely with Corporate Development, Sales, Finance, Product, Product Marketing, Deal Desk, Legal, and regional Strategy and Operations teams to support due diligence, integration planning, launch readiness, and post-acquisition execution.

What you’ll do

You’ll lead the sales strategy and operations work required to assess and integrate acquisitions into Stripe’s GTM organization. You’ll develop integration plans, design operating models, coordinate cross-functional execution, and help sales teams successfully bring acquired products to market.

Responsibilities

• Partner with Corporate Development and GTM leaders during due diligence to assess sales motions, organizational structure, pipeline, customer segments, coverage models, systems, and operational risks

• Translate acquisition strategy into an executable GTM integration plan with clear workstreams, owners, milestones, dependencies, decision points, and success measures

• Design sales operating models for acquired products, including coverage, segmentation, account ownership, rules of engagement, lead routing, specialist support, partner motions, and customer expansion paths

• Evaluate how acquired teams, products, customers, and pipelines should connect with Stripe’s existing sales processes and rhythm of business

• Establish launch and integration readiness criteria covering seller readiness, systems and data, enablement, quoting, reporting, customer handoffs, and post-launch support

• Coordinate execution across Sales, Corporate Development, Finance, Product, Product Marketing, Enablement, Deal Desk, Legal, and systems teams

• Identify integration risks and execution gaps, recommend practical solutions, and escalate decisions with clear context and tradeoffs

• Develop reporting and operating mechanisms that help leaders monitor integration progress, field adoption, pipeline health, and business performance

• Support pricing, packaging, product catalog, quota, compensation, forecasting, and quote-to-cash workstreams in partnership with the relevant functional owners

• Help establish durable ownership for ongoing processes before work transitions out of the integration phase

• Build reusable due diligence, Day 1, Day 30, Day 90, launch readiness, and post-integration playbooks for future acquisitions

• Use data and qualitative insights to evaluate integration outcomes and recommend adjustments to GTM strategy and execution

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you’re encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Finance, Economics, Management, or a related field.

• 10+ years of experience in sales strategy and operations, revenue operations, M&A integration, corporate strategy, management consult

title: City Scout - Kuala Lumpur
description:
About Atlys
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
Atlys is changing that.
We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries . But we’re still early.
The Role
We're looking for a City Scout to help build the most reliable database of work-friendly cafes for travellers.
You'll visit cafes across your assigned city, verify information like WiFi quality, internet speed, plug points and overall work-friendliness, and submit accurate data that powers a new Atlys product. Every visit directly improves the travel experience for thousands of users.
The Job

• Explore and discover great cafes: Visit assigned cafes across your city, experience them as a customer, and identify places that travellers would genuinely enjoy working from.

• Collect high-quality on-ground data: Verify key details including WiFi availability, internet speed, passwords, plug points, seating, ambience and overall work-friendliness to ensure the information is accurate and reliable.

• Contribute to a travel product used by thousands: Capture your observations by completing a short digital survey after every visit, helping build one of the world's most reliable databases of work-friendly cafes.

• Cover your city efficiently: Plan your visits across assigned neighbourhood clusters to maximize coverage while maintaining consistency and quality.

• Maintain exceptional data quality: Pay close attention to detail, validate every submission, and ensure the information travellers see on the Atlys app can be trusted.

The Ideal Candidate
You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

• Are a college student or have a flexible part-time schedule.

• Enjoy exploring your city and discovering new places.

• Have strong attention to detail and collect information accurately.

• Are comfortable travelling independently within your city.

• Own a smartphone and are reliable, proactive and self-driven.

We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.
What you can expect
Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
Here’s what you can expect:

• Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.

• Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.

• A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.

• Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office , so the basics are taken care of while we build together.

• Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.

• Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.

• Great tools to do your best work , including high-spec equipment and software.

• An office designed for more than just work , with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
Come build the intelligence layer for global travel

title: Senior Partner Acquisition Manager - Germany
description:
Senior Partner Acquisition Manager (m/f/d) - Partner Acquisition Germany
Berlin or Frankfurt (Germany)
We're looking for a Senior Partner Acquisition Manager (m/f/d)
You'll own iwoca 's most strategic partnerships in Germany, from the first conversation with a bank, payment provider or business software platform to a live integration that funds small businesses. Your mission is to bring fast, flexible finance to the places where SMEs already run their business.
The company
Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.
That's why we built iwoca . Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.
We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4.5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.
The team
The Partner Acquisition Germany team builds the partner channel through which iwoca reaches small businesses in Germany: comparison platforms and brokers, banks, payment providers, business software providers and financial advisors who offer iwoca 's finance to their customers at the moment it is needed. The team works with three partnership models, from a co-branded referral link and a partner portal to a full API integration, and measures its success by partners that are live and funding customers.
The team is small and works closely together: the Head of Partner Acquisition Germany, a Strategy & Data Manager who owns market analysis, business cases and the CRM, and the partner managers who own the relationships. The team prioritises partners by strategic fit, works through warm introductions and existing networks wherever possible, and stays close to every new partner until the first customers are funded. It works hand in hand with Relationship Management and the product and engineering teams in London / Berlin / Frankfurt that build the integrations.
The role
This is a senior role with full ownership of the partners you pursue. Three things matter more than anything else: You will qualify before you sell, because the best partnerships begin with a genuine customer need. You know how to activate networks and create warm introductions rather than relying solely on cold outreach. And you consider a deal complete only when the partnership is live, working well and funding its first customers. You'll travel across Germany one to two days a week for face-to-face partner meetings, industry events and trade fairs.
Ownership and impact

• Own a portfolio of the highest-value partnership prospects in Germany, from first conversation to signed contract and live integration.

• Lead negotiations with founders, managing directors and heads of product or partnerships at banks, payment providers, business software platforms and financial intermediaries.

• Design the cooperation model and commercial terms for each partner so that the partnership works for both sides over years, not quarters.

• Bring every partner to go-live with a committed internal promoter and a first concrete use case, so that your work turns into funded customers and long-term value.

Autonomy, backed by a dedicated strategy and data function

• Spend your time on relationships and deals, with a Strategy & Data Manager who builds target models, business cases and CRM automation alongside you for your prospects and partners.

• Own your pipeline end to end and keep it transparent, so that forecasts and decisions rest on input and numbers everyone trusts.

• Decide together with the Head of Partner Acquisition w

Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) $62 K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. title: Staff Software Engineer - Postgres Control Plane
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is now building a world class OLTP service on Postgres. We’re hiring Senior Postgres Engineers to help build the new Snowflake Postgres service. This is an exciting opportunity to help build a large scale, multi-cloud Postgres offering with access to an existing customer base.

AS A SENIOR POSTGRES ENGINEER YOU WILL:

- Develop orchestration layer/ control-plane of large scale databases

- Work with AWS, Azure, and GCP APIs

- Build High Availability and Disaster Recovery solutions

- Tune Postgres to operate at scale for some of the largest datasets in the world

- Secure and ensure customer data is protected

- Work alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry and help redefine the space by inventing at various layers of the software stack - from broad distributed systems to low-level optimizations that fundamentally change the performance characteristics of the system to cater to our customer needs.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR POSTGRES ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

- 7+ years industry experience designing, building and developing large scale systems in production

- Experience building and maintaining distributed, highly available, fault tolerant services

- Excellent understanding of low level operating systems concepts including multi-threading, memory management, networking, storage, performance, and scale

- Extremely strong fundamental computer science skills

- Experience with Java, Python/Ruby & Go

- Experience running & maintaining large Postgres servers

- Familiarity with cloud networking (VPCs, PrivateLink, Peering, etc)

- Experience working with remote, geographically distributed teams

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

THE FOLLOWING ARE CONSIDERED A PLUS:

- Bachelors, Masters, or PhD in Computer Science

- Deep, expert knowledge of Postgres (WAL, extensions, configuration, replication, etc)

- Experience designing and implementing large systems for public or private clouds

- FedRAMP and DoD deployment experience

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
